findings.message: Entry param filtro (filter:listaTarefas, persisted) has no state in the defs. Added the persisted public state `filtro` (null = all my tasks); qryMinhasTarefas(filtro) publishes it and loads from the first page.

State selectedTarefa (select:detalheTarefa) has no setter and the contract has qryTarefa(tarefaId). Selecting goes through qryTarefa(id | null), which publishes selectedTarefa and writes the fetched record to `tarefa`.

The defs have no <command>.input states for the forms. Added public drafts with setters: cmdCriarTarefaDraft (with generated chaveCriacao, prefilled by the listaId and responsavelId entry params), cmdSalvarEdicaoDraft, cmdSalvarChecklistDraft and cmdDevolverDraft (setCmdCriarTarefaDraft, setCmdSalvarEdicaoDraft, setCmdSalvarChecklistDraft, setCmdDevolverDraft), plus clearCmdCriarTarefaDraft and resetEdicaoDrafts.

A task created by cmdCriarTarefa is not inserted in `tarefas`: the summary row needs backend-computed indicators (venceHoje, atrasada, quantidadeSubtarefas, progressoChecklist) that the shared must not compute. The page may call qryMinhasTarefas() to reload.

After commands that return a task, the existing row in `tarefas` is updated by id from the detail (status, people, list, deadline, priority, version, devolvidaEm) or removed when it no longer matches the current filter, but the computed indicators of the row (venceHoje, atrasada, progressoChecklist, quantidadeSubtarefas) stay as loaded until the list is reloaded.
